dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "O guests from afar who have scaled mountains on your way, the Scions of the Canopy extend their greetings to you."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "This is the Bulletin Board for our tribe's affairs. May here you find the information you seek, as well as a path to the attainment of your hopes."
